The **Axiom of Countable Choice**, written $\mathrm{AC}_\omega$, is the following
statement.

> For every family $(X_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ of nonempty sets indexed by
> $\mathbb{N}$ there is a function $f$ with domain $\mathbb{N}$ such that
> $f(n) \in X_n$ for every $n \in \mathbb{N}$.

The branch is specified by
$$
\rho=\rho_0,\qquad \operatorname{div}u=0,\qquad
\sigma=-pI_3+2\mu D,\qquad
\rho_0D_tu=\operatorname{div}\sigma,
$$

Consequently, for every $t\in I$,

$$\frac{d}{dt}\frac12\int_{\mathbb T_L^d}|\overline u_\ell|^2\,d\mu_L+\nu\int_{\mathbb T_L^d}|\nabla\overline u_\ell|_F^2\,d\mu_L=\int_{\mathbb T_L^d}\tau_\ell:\nabla\overline u_\ell\,d\mu_L+\int_{\mathbb T_L^d}\overline f_\ell\cdot\overline u_\ell\,d\mu_L.$$

The forward-transfer sign convention is $\Pi_\ell=-\tau_\ell:\nabla\overline u_\ell$; this theorem makes no sign assertion for $\Pi_\ell$.

then the filtered field has the same regularity and, for every spatial multi-index $\beta$,

$$\partial_x^\beta\overline q_\ell=\overline{\partial_x^\beta q}_\ell,\qquad \partial_t\partial_x^\beta\overline q_\ell=\overline{\partial_t\partial_x^\beta q}_\ell.$$

For any smooth periodic vector field $u:\mathbb T_L^d\to\mathbb R^d$, define the subfilter stress and transfer by

$$\tau_\ell=\overline{u\otimes u}_\ell-\overline u_\ell\otimes\overline u_\ell,\qquad \Pi_\ell=-\tau_\ell:\nabla\overline u_\ell,$$

derivations.claim: Decompose the resolved gradient into its symmetric part D_ell and skew-symmetric part W_ell. Pairing entries (i,j) and (j,i) cancels each off-diagonal contraction and the diagonal of W_ell is zero, so D_ell:grad(ubar_ell)=|D_ell|_F^2.
Derivative commutation and div(u)=0 give div(ubar_ell)=0; therefore I_3:grad(ubar_ell)=0.
Contracting the adopted model stress with grad(ubar_ell), its isotropic term vanishes by step 1.2 and its deviatoric term is -2nu_t|D_ell|_F^2 by step 1.1. Thus Pi_model=2nu_t|D_ell|_F^2>=0.

Under the additional nu>0 equation hypotheses, the exact filtered energy identity has +tau_ell:grad(ubar_ell) on the right. The adopted model replaces that stress slot by tau_model, whose contribution is -Pi_model<=0 by step 2.1; this is not a sign assertion about exact tau_ell.
